scientific_integrity: The sign is established by an exact rational identity and integer comparison. The critical mixed-state formula is taken from the defining source and specialized algebraically to order \(2\). The accompanying exact-arithmetic checker is a reproducibility aid rather than evidence for an infinite or optimization claim.
scientific_limitations: The result is one exact Rényi-\(2\) strong-superadditivity witness. It does not establish global optimality, characterize the full violating region, cover all Rényi orders above \(1\), or settle the proposed equivalence with second-order-monogamy violation.
title: An exact four-term strong-superadditivity counterexample for Rényi-\(2\) entanglement
